user_query: I'm organizing a language workshop for my friends and we want to learn different languages. Can you provide me with a list of languages supported by LanguageTool API? Additionally, I need to extract information about a product from an e-commerce shopping page. Please retrieve the product details from the URL 'http://www.amazon.com/Kindle-Ereader-ebook-reader/dp/B007HCCNJU/' and provide me with the offer price and regular price of the product.

TaskList.description: Fetch the list of languages supported by the LanguageTool API.
Retrieve the product details, including the offer price and regular price, from the specified e-commerce URL.
